agentaBotDesc: Scan a code and start chatting.
botFatherBody: Send <cmd>/newbot</cmd>, then pick a name and a username ending in “bot”.
copyValuesBody: The phone number ID from WhatsApp > API Setup, a permanent token for a system user from Meta Business Settings, and the app secret from App settings > Basic.
credsBody: Copy these from the app's settings in Slack. We check them with Slack, and they stay masked after saving.
existingAppDesc: Reuse an app you already created in Slack.
factMaintainBody: No manifest or secrets. Disconnect any time.
factReadsBody: Channels you invite it to, plus DMs.
factThreadsBody: Mention {{handle}} in a channel to get an answer from {{agent}}.
finishInSlack: Finish the install in the Slack window…
handleHelp: Letters, numbers, periods, hyphens and underscores.
hostedDocsLink: Set up the hosted bot on a self-hosted deployment (docs)
identityTitle: How it shows up in Slack
linkExpiredBody: Nothing was linked. Get a new link and open it within the time shown.
manifestBody: In Slack, choose Create New App → From a manifest, pick your workspace and paste this. Then install the app to your workspace.
manifestTitle: Create the app from a manifest
metaAppBody: In Meta’s App Dashboard, create a Business app and add the WhatsApp product.
metaAppTitle: Create a Meta app with WhatsApp
newAppDesc: Start from a manifest we fill in for {{agent}}.
noHostedSlack: This deployment has no hosted Slack app. Connect your own app instead.
noManifest: No manifest is available for this deployment.
ownAppDesc: Your name and avatar. About 5 min.
pasteHereBody: We check them with Meta before saving. Secrets stay masked after you save.
pasteTokenBody: We check it with Telegram, then keep it masked.
scanBody: {{handle}} asks you to confirm, then this chat is linked to {{agent}}.
slackDidNotOpen: Slack didn’t open? Open it here.
slackInstallStartError: Could not start the Slack install.
slackInstallTimeout: Slack didn’t finish the install. The authorization window was closed or Slack returned an error. Nothing was saved — try again.
slackNote: One Slack workspace routes to one agent. Direct messages work right away.
slackNoteAdding: Your other workspaces stay connected. Each workspace answers as one agent.
telegramCustomNote: Your bot answers only as this agent. Other bots stay connected.
telegramHostedNote: Group chats appear here after someone mentions the bot in them once.
telegramLinked: Linked. {{agent}} answers in that Telegram chat now.
telegramUnavailable: The hosted Telegram bot is not available on this deployment. Use your own bot instead.
whatsappConnected: Connected. One step left in Meta.
whatsappNote: Meta bills your business directly for WhatsApp messages.
